50985-a-treatise-on-acupuncturation.creator: Unknown
50985-a-treatise-on-acupuncturation.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The operation of acupuncturation has been seen by so few Europeans, that our books have made us acquainted with little more than its name. It is of Asiatic origin, and China and Japan peculiarly claim it as their own. A writer in the year 1802, mentions a discovery of its having been practised by the natives of America, and refers to Dampier’s voyages for an account of it; but I have in vain followed Capt.

59518-the-theory-of-stock-exchange-specu.title: Speculation.
59518-the-theory-of-stock-exchange-specu.creator: Arthur Crump.
59518-the-theory-of-stock-exchange-specu.description: A book by Arthur Crump.. I do not agree with Mr. Crump, that a speculator, to be successful, must be a hard-hearted, selfish man. I found it different with most of the prominent men in Wall Street. Of course, if a Gould or a Vanderbilt buys up a whole railroad, he cannot very well take many people into his confidence; but these men are not what is generally called speculators—they are generals or diplomats, and they are not different in their actions from generals in warfare or diplomats in politics.

arxiv-1909-10986.title: Regression methods in waveform modeling: a comparative study
arxiv-1909-10986.creator: Yoshinta Setyawati, Michael Pürrer, Frank Ohme
arxiv-1909-10986.description: Abstract Gravitational-wave astronomy of compact binaries relies on theoretical models of the gravitational-wave signal that is emitted as binaries coalesce. These models do not only need to be accurate, they also have to be fast to evaluate in order to be able to compare millions of signals in near real time with the data of gravitational-wave instruments.

arxiv-2011-10691.title: Tau Functions of ( n , 1 ) (n,1) curves and Soliton Solutions on Non-Zero Constant Backgrounds
arxiv-2011-10691.creator: Atsushi Nakayashiki
arxiv-2011-10691.description: Abstract We study the tau function of the KP-hierarchy associated with an ( n , 1 ) (n,1) curve y n = x − α y^{n}=x-\alpha . If α = 0 \alpha=0 the corresponding tau function is 1 1 .

arxiv-2101-11500.title: A Deterministic Algorithm for the Discrete Logarithm Problem in a Semigroup
arxiv-2101-11500.creator: Simran Tinani, Joachim Rosenthal
arxiv-2101-11500.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Simran Tinani, Joachim Rosenthal. The discrete logarithm problem in a finite group is the basis for many protocols in cryptography. The best general algorithms which solve this problem have time complexity of 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(\sqrt{N}\log N) , and a space complexity of 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(\sqrt{N}) where N N is the order of the group.

arxiv-2202-04133.title: Comparison of all atom and united atom models for thermal transport calculations of amorphous polyethylene
arxiv-2202-04133.creator: James Wu, Debashish Mukherji
arxiv-2202-04133.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by James Wu, Debashish Mukherji. Polymer simulations routinely employ models with different molecular resolutions. United atom (UA) models are one such example, where groups of certain atoms in a molecule are clustered into superatoms. Although their computational simplicity makes them particularly attractive for studying a wide range of polymer properties, the missing degrees of freedom in UA models can impact certain properties that are intimately linked to localized vibrations, such as the heat capacity and the thermal transport coefficient κ \kappa .

arxiv-2205-12821.title: The complexity of blocking (semi)total dominating sets with edge contractions
arxiv-2205-12821.creator: Esther Galby
arxiv-2205-12821.description: Abstract We consider the problem of reducing the (semi)total domination number of graph by one by contracting edges. It is known that this can always be done with at most three edge contractions and that deciding whether one edge contraction suffices is an 𝖭𝖯 \mathsf{NP} -hard problem.

arxiv-2311-12038.title: Modular Arithmetic Study on Ascending and Descending Operations Related with Collatz Conjecture and Origin of the Operation Journal: Indagationes Mathematicae
arxiv-2311-12038.creator: Kyo Jin Ihn
arxiv-2311-12038.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kyo Jin Ihn. Sequence of numbers generated by the recurrence relation based on the Collatz conjecture is investigated. An arithmetic operation on the Collatz conjecture is called descending operation, and ascending operation is carried out reversely to the descending operation. Study on the 3 ​ x + 1 3x+1 problem against every integer is relevant to that of descending operation against every odd. Any odds can be generated by ascending operations against odds not multiple of 3, and vise versa.

arxiv-2311-13266.title: Spontaneous polarization in NaNbO 3 film on NdGaO 3 and DyScO 3 substrates
arxiv-2311-13266.creator: Kisung Kang, Saud Bin Anooz, Jutta Schwarzkopf, Christian Carbogno
arxiv-2311-13266.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kisung Kang, Saud Bin Anooz, Jutta Schwarzkopf, Christian Carbogno. Pure NaNbO 3 is an antiferroelectric material at room temperature that irreversibly transforms to a ferroelectric polar state when subjected to an external electrical field or lattice strain. Experimentally, it has been observed that NaNbO 3 films grown on NdGaO 3 exhibit an electrical polarization along the [001] PC direction, whereas films on DyScO 3 substrates exhibit a polarization along the [011] PC direction.

arxiv-2402-11418.title: Capturing many-body correlation effects with quantum and classical computing
arxiv-2402-11418.creator: Karol Kowalski, Nicholas P. Bauman, Guang Hao Low, Martin Roetteler, John J. Rehr, Fernando D. Vila
arxiv-2402-11418.description: Abstract Theoretical descriptions of excited states of molecular systems in high-energy regimes are crucial for supporting and driving many experimental efforts at light source facilities. However, capturing their complicated correlation effects requires formalisms that provide a hierarchical infrastructure of approximations.

arxiv-2503-05158.title: Strong Amplitude Modulation of Hard-band X-ray QPO with Soft-band Flux in RE J1034+396
arxiv-2503-05158.creator: Ruisong Xia, Hao Liu ✉, Yongquan Xue ✉
arxiv-2503-05158.description: Abstract The X-ray quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) is a remarkable form of variability in systems of compact object accretion. RE J1034+396, harboring the most significant X-ray QPO in active galactic nuclei (AGNs), is the most noteworthy source for in-depth analysis of AGN X-ray QPO properties. A long-term evolution of its QPO has been observed over the course of the observations.

arxiv-2506-14474.title: LexiMark: Robust Watermarking via Lexical Substitutions to Enhance Membership Verification of an LLM’s Textual Training Data
arxiv-2506-14474.creator: Eyal German, Sagiv Antebi, Edan Habler, Asaf Shabtai, Yuval Elovici
arxiv-2506-14474.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can be trained or fine-tuned on data obtained without the owner’s consent. Verifying whether a specific LLM was trained on particular data instances or an entire dataset is extremely challenging. Dataset watermarking addresses this by embedding identifiable modifications in training data to detect unauthorized use.

arxiv-2507-19304.title: Multistream Network for LiDAR and Camera-based 3D Object Detection in Outdoor Scenes
arxiv-2507-19304.creator: Muhammad Ibrahim ID, Naveed Akhtar ID, Haitian Wang ID, Saeed Anwar, Ajmal Mian ID
arxiv-2507-19304.description: Abstract Fusion of LiDAR and RGB data has the potential to enhance outdoor 3D object detection accuracy. To address real-world challenges in outdoor 3D object detection, fusion of LiDAR and RGB input has started gaining traction. However, effective integration of these modalities for precise object detection task still remains a largely open problem.

arxiv-2507-20537.title: Next-Generation Quantum Neural Networks: Enhancing Efficiency, Security, and Privacy
arxiv-2507-20537.creator: Nouhaila Innan 1 2 , Muhammad Kashif 1 2 , Alberto Marchisio 1 2 , Mohamed Bennai 3 , Muhammad Shafique 1 2
arxiv-2507-20537.description: Abstract This paper provides an integrated perspective on addressing key challenges in developing reliable and secure Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era. In this paper, we present an integrated framework that leverages and combines existing approaches to enhance QNN efficiency, security, and privacy.

arxiv-2511-15837.title: Scalable Privilege Analysis for Multi-Cloud Big Data Platforms: A Hypergraph Approach
arxiv-2511-15837.creator: Sai Sitharaman 1 , Hassan Karim 2 , Deepti Gupta 3 , Mudit Tyagi 1
arxiv-2511-15837.description: Abstract The rapid adoption of multi-cloud environments has amplified risks associated with privileged access mismanagement. Traditional Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions based on Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) exhibit cubic O ⁡ ( n 3 ) O(n^{3}) complexity, rendering real-time privilege analysis intractable at enterprise scale.

arxiv-2601-03603.title: A Comparative Study of Traditional Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Large Language Models for Mental Health Forecasting using Smartphone Sensing Data Journal: IMWUT Volume: 0 0 0 0 CCS: Human-centered computing Ubiquitous and mobile computing CCS: Applied computing Life and medical sciences CCS:
arxiv-2601-03603.creator: Kaidong Feng, Zhu Sun, Roy Ka-Wei LEE, Xun Jiang, Yin-Leng Theng, Yi Ding
arxiv-2601-03603.description: Abstract . Smartphone sensing offers an unobtrusive and scalable way to track daily behaviors linked to mental health, capturing changes in sleep, mobility, and phone use that often precede symptoms of stress, anxiety, or depression. While most prior studies focus on detection that responds to existing conditions, forecasting mental health enables proactive support through Just-in-Time Adaptive Interventions.

uslaw-usc-t12-s1747b.title: 12 U.S.C. § 1747b — Premium charges; fees for examination and inspection
uslaw-usc-t12-s1747b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s1747b.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 13 (National Housing); Subchapter VII (Insurance For Investments In Rental Housing For Families Of Moderate Income). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) For insurance granted pursuant to this subchapter the Secretary shall fix and collect a premium charge in an amount not exceeding one-half of 1 per centum of the outstanding investment for.

uslaw-usc-t15-s24.title: 15 U.S.C. § 24 — Liability of directors and agents of corporation
uslaw-usc-t15-s24.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s24.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 1 (Monopolies And Combinations In Restraint Of Trade). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever a corporation shall violate any of the penal provisions of the antitrust laws, such violation shall be deemed to be also that of the individual directors, officers, or agents of such corporation who shall have authorized, ordered, or done.

uslaw-usc-t15-s6307h.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6307h — Judges and referees
uslaw-usc-t15-s6307h.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6307h.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 89 (Professional Boxing Safety). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No person may arrange, promote, organize, produce, or fight in a professional boxing match unless all referees and judges participating in the match have been certified and approved by the boxing commission responsible for regulating the match in the State where the match is.
